notes.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion launches later this year!
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes!

[b]Tribute Games[/b], [b]Dotemu[/b], and [b]Marvel Games[/b] assemble today to announce [b][i]MARVEL Cosmic Invasion[/i][/b], an [b]arcade-style beat ‘em up[/b] featuring an incredible roster of characters from Marvel’s golden eras!

Catch a first glimpse of the [b]cosmic adventure[/b] awaiting you later this year in our announcement trailer:

[previewyoutube=19_uUhZsjsg;full][ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER LINK][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A Cosmic Battle awaits![/h3]
After Annihilus has launched an unprecedented attack across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance. [b]Nova, Spider-Man, Wolverine, Phyla-Vell, Captain America,[/b] and many more heroes, both earth-born and cosmic, will join forces in a [b]star-spanning brawling adventure[/b] against the [b]deadly Annihilation Wave.[/b]

Get ready to [b]brawl[/b] through the streets of New York City and all the way to the depths of the Negative Zone to foil Annihilus’ plan to spread death across the cosmos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558595/665ec4ff6536837f0d341d844d34f13d6b4b5ca4.png[/img]
[h3]Assemble your team to face the Annihilation Wave![/h3]
In [i]MARVEL Cosmic Invasion[/i], choose from [b]15 of Marvel’s greatest Super Heroes[/b] to create your own team of [b]two characters[/b] and fight against the intergalactic conqueror Annihilus!
Tag between them mid-fight with the innovative [b][u]Cosmic Swap[/u][/b] system, and capitalize on each character’s abilities to create [b]unique combos[/b] and [b]powerful special attacks[/b]! 
With its [b]dynamic combat combos[/b] and [b]dazzling pixel art[/b], this planet-hopping adventure stands as a true love letter to the Marvel Universe!

[i]MARVEL Cosmic Invasion[/i]’s action will support [b]four-player[/b] drop-in/drop-out [b]local[/b] and [b]online co-op[/b] with [b]crossplay[/b]!

From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the fate of the universe will be fought for across the stars!

[h3]Wishlist [I]MARVEL Cosmic Invasion[/i] NOW![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753970/MARVEL_Cosmic_Invasion/

Keep up with the latest news by joining us on social media!

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/MARVELCosmicInvasion]Facebook - MARVEL Cosmic Invasion[/url]
[/list]
